item.title: Lapis vs Lor vs Sailor in 2026: Which Lua Web Framework Should You Actually Ship On?
item.description: Lua web development is a small world with an outsized reputation: sites like itch.io serve enormous traffic from code that runs inside Nginx, not in front of it. That efficiency comes from OpenResty, which pairs Nginx with LuaJIT. But once you decide to build on it, you hit the real question — and the honest answer surprises most developers.
